question: Equilibrium national income occurs where aggregate supply _______
solution:
The correct solution is __**equal aggregate demand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Equilibrium national income**
 
• The total quantity of new "final" goods and services created over time, often measured annually and quarterly, is a **country's national income**. 
 
• When the level of national output (**usually measured as Gross Domestic Product, or GDP)**, stays stable throughout time, it is said to be in a state of **national income equilibrium**.
 
• **There are two ways to think about GDP equilibrium:**
 
• First, a stable GDP will happen when an **economy's aggregate supply (AS) and aggregate demand (AD) are exactly balanced**; and
